mainEntity.name: How long should a password be?

acceptedAnswer.text: At least 16 characters for a random password, and longer for important accounts. NIST guidance stresses length over complexity rules.
A measure of unpredictability in bits. Each extra bit doubles the number of guesses needed. Above about 80 bits is very hard to brute force.

mainEntity.name: Are passphrases as good as passwords?

acceptedAnswer.text: A passphrase of enough random words is strong and easier to remember. Six words from this list is about 58 bits; seven or eight is stronger.
It only matters if you type the password by hand. It slightly reduces the pool, so add a couple of characters to compensate.
